headline: Thursday, November 12 — sunny 71 with a storm lineup behind it, Granite forms still waiting

sections.lead: Last day of the light, momentum-heavy Moon: it finishes Sagittarius this morning and slips into Capricorn tonight, which shifts the mood from bright and chatty to practical and heads-down.
items: Plain read: morning is your push window, and the Sun is lining up easy with your natal Mercury, so forms and reading go smoothly
This afternoon's video visit lands right as the practical Capricorn energy arrives, which suits a check-the-box kind of appointment
Mercury is still retrograde across from your Sun, so the standing caveat holds: read each form twice before you submit
How to use it: Granite forms in the morning while the energy is bright, then coast into the 12:30 visit

Details: Moon Sagittarius 29.9 entering Capricorn tonight, waxing crescent (39 deg elongation); Sun trine natal Mercury (orb 1.0); Venus retro conjunct natal Moon (orb 1.8); Moon sextile natal Moon (orb 2.9); Neptune retro trine natal Venus (orb 0.6); Pluto sextile natal Moon (orb 1.0); Mercury retro square natal Sun (orb 2.5); Saturn retro trine natal Sun (orb 2.5); first quarter Moon Monday

sections.lead: The election result that hits your commute: the Bay Area transit sales tax is leading.
